blocks.html: A palatable feast of best-loved Filipino food will delight foodies at the Fiesta Comida De La Calle (translated as Street Food Festival) from April 24 to May 3 at Robinsons Place Manila’s Padre Faura Wing. Fiesta Comida De La Calle is Robinsons Place Manila’s way of celebrating Department of Tourism’s month-long food festival dubbed as “Flavors of the Philippines.”
